notes: 59 effort x cost x score points transcribed exactly from the four inline SVG charts' aria-labels in the Haiku 5.5 launch post (machine-readable accessibility data, not pixel digitization). Charts: OSWorld 2.1 offline subset (partial credit), GDPval-AA v2.1, Humanity's Last Exam (no tools), and Terminal-Bench 4.0. Terminal-Bench 4.0 shows Sonnet 5.5 twice, at $0.10 and $0.20 cache-read prices; both series are kept. 'Med' is normalized to medium; each row keeps its exact label in caveat. Costs are USD as printed (per attempt on OSWorld/HLE/TB4.0, per task on GDPval-AA); unit usd_per_task is used for all. Haiku 4.5 points carry effort null. These points share snapshot and comparability_group with the launch table rows for the same benchmark.
